items.title: DIA Reports Sales Of €2.9bn In H1 2026, Outpaces Spanish Retail Market Growth
items.summary: Supermarket chain DIA reported gross sales of €2.9 billion for the first half of its 2026 financial year – up 11.6%, year on year.

items.title: CMA Considers Remedies Package For Southern Co-op Deal
items.summary: Britain's competition regulator is considering the remedies offered by Co-op for its proposed merger with Southern Co-op.

items.title: UK Food And Drink Exports Hit Multi-Year Low, Trade Deficit Widens – FDF
items.summary: The UK’s food and drink export volumes have plunged to their third-lowest level this millennium, imports remain near record highs.

items.title: Coca-Cola expands bottling plant in Ghent
items.summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners Belgium and Luxembourg has invested 36 million euros in its production and distribution facility in Ghent. The company plans to increase capacity there from 350 to 450 million liters per year.

items.title: Management buy-out at Prénatal: CEO is new owner
items.summary: Prénatal is getting a new owner: CEO Jochem van Bueren is acquiring all shares in the Dutch maternity and children's retailer from the German investor Mutares.

items.title: Is Capri Holdings, the owner of Michael Kors and Jimmy Choo, looking for a buyer?
items.summary: Capri Holdings is exploring a possible sale of the group. There are reportedly interested parties, and the company has already made informal contact with investors who are considering a takeover. The fashion group previously sold off Versace.

items.title: Why mid-strength spirits offer new threat to wine industry
items.summary: Diageo’s move into ‘mid-strength’ spirits could provide momentum to the emerging product area – and another challenge to under-pressure winemakers.

items.title: Putin now also takes control of Metro Russia
items.summary: After the Russian Federation had previously seized control of the local operations of Nestlé, Auchan, and Leroy Merlin, Metro Russia is now also being placed under receivership. As a result, Metro AG no longer has operational control over its subsidiary.

items.title: Nestlé breaks down its path to 2030 for virgin plastic reduction
items.summary: Plastic accounted for about a quarter of the food and beverage giant's packaging portfolio by weight in 2025.

items.title: Mondelēz Expands Harmony Into Independent European Wheat Certification
items.summary: Mondelēz International has announced that its Harmony Label is evolving into an independent sustainability certification scheme.

items.title: Picnic hires Amazon executive Eva Faict
items.summary: Eva Faict, Amazon's country manager for Belgium and the Netherlands, who recently announced her departure, has already landed a new challenge: she will be strengthening the international operations of the Dutch online grocery store Picnic.

items.title: Suntory eyes more “fractional launches” after Jim Beam UK push
items.summary: Suntory Holdings is lining up the launch of more small-sized products in UK convenience stores amid demand for "accessible" versions of its spirits brands.

items.title: Albert Heijn to replace Delhaize in Lommel
items.summary: Albert Heijn will open a supermarket in Lommel before the end of the year. The retailer will take over a location there that was operated by a Delhaize franchisee until February. This brings the retailer’s total number of store openings in Belgium this year to five.

items.title: Gamma is scaling back its Belgian operations to focus on Flanders
items.summary: In Belgium, the DIY chain Gamma is shifting its focus away from the French-speaking part of the country to concentrate more attention and investment on Flanders. There, the company aims to expand to 75 to 80 stores in the coming years.

items.title: “Carrefour to pay 155 million euros for Colruyt Group’s French neighborhood store division”
items.summary: According to the French business publication La Lettre, Carrefour is on the verge of acquiring Codifrance, the Colruyt Group subsidiary that supplies neighborhood stores such as Coccinelle and Coccimarket.

items.title: Vinarchy takes Echo Falls wine brand into RTDs
items.summary: Vinarchy has added an RTD option for wine brand Echo Falls in the UK.

items.title: Habitat returns to INNO
items.summary: Habitat is making a physical comeback in Belgium: starting October 7, the design brand will have a permanent shop-in-shop at the INNO store on Nieuwstraat in Brussels. The home decor specialist had already launched an online store.

items.title: UK dairy firm All Things lands in US in first overseas push
items.summary: All Things has made its first move outside the UK with a launch in the US at Whole Foods Market. The post UK dairy firm All Things lands in US in first overseas push appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: [In the picture] Jumbo Golf aims to be Belgium’s most hospitable specialty golf shop
items.summary: Jumbo Golf’s first Belgian location opened in Stekene just over a year ago. Now that the Dutch parent company has gotten to know and understand Belgian golfers better, the store is ready for a “Grand Opening.”

items.title: EU Households Accounted For Over Half Of Food Waste In 2024 - Eurostat
items.summary: Households accounted for more than half of all food waste (53%) in the EU in 2024, according to new data released by Eurostat.

items.title: Tesco Names AgroSustain And Herd Advance As Agri-Tech Challenge Winners 2026
items.summary: UK retailer Tesco has announced the winners of its 2026 Agri-tech Challenge, which supports technological innovations in agriculture.

items.title: Colruyt Group Secures Independent Certification For Green-Score Eco-Label
items.summary: Belgium’s Colruyt has secured independent certification for its Green-score environmental system under new legal requirements.

items.title: Sephora to open 100 beauty stores within Marks & Spencer stores across the UK
items.summary: Sephora is teaming up with Marks & Spencer in the British market. Starting in the spring of 2027, the beauty brand will have shop-in-shops in 100 M&S stores and its own product lineup on the department store chain’s online store.

items.title: Britain's Greggs Raises Profit Outlook On Improved Trading
items.summary: Greggs has lifted its annual profit outlook after stronger Q3 sales, and proposed four factory closures amid expansion plans.

items.title: Saudi Arabia meat group Tanmiah outlines APAC halal deal
items.summary: Saudi Arabia poultry company Tanmiah Food has signed a MoU with Malaysian food company Tradewinds to cooperate on halal protein. The post Saudi Arabia meat group Tanmiah outlines APAC halal deal appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Alt‑milk options battle soy’s dominance in Japan
items.summary: Soy’s ascendancy in Japan’s milk‑alternatives market looks set to continue but, Kathryn Wortley reports, brands believe there are opportunities for other ingredients. The post Alt‑milk options battle soy’s dominance in Japan appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Metro Russia Placed Under Temporary Forced Administration By Russian Government
items.summary: Russia's government has placed wholesaler Metro Russia under temporary forced administration with immediate effect.

items.title: Hain Celestial wins extension to regain Nasdaq listing compliance
items.summary: Hain Celestial has been given an extension into the new year to regain compliance with Nasdaq listing rules or consider a stock split. The post Hain Celestial wins extension to regain Nasdaq listing compliance appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Lindt & Sprüngli cuts sales forecast as pricing eats into volumes
items.summary: Lindt & Sprüngli has lowered its forecast for its annual organic sales, citing the impact of price increases and weaker volumes. The post Lindt & Sprüngli cuts sales forecast as pricing eats into volumes appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Why online brand Pit&Pit appears in Bio-Planet stores
items.summary: Pit&Pit, the Belgian online store specializing in healthy and natural foods, is expanding into the brick-and-mortar world with its own shelves in four Bio-Planet stores, the Colruyt Group’s organic chain.

items.title: Target Lowers Prices On Nearly 2,000 Items Ahead Of Holiday Season
items.summary: Target said it is lowering prices on nearly 2,000 products to attract cash-strapped shoppers ahead of the holiday season.

items.title: RFK Jr’s food policy priorities need more resources to implement, FDA nominee says
items.summary: Heidi Overton said the agency requires more support to enact mandatory GRAS notifications while also backing a federal standard on ingredient regulation once enough states have taken action.

items.title: Molson Coors bets on nonalcoholic drinks with national expansion
items.summary: The Coors owner plans to further scale its Coors 0.0 brand and launch a nonalcoholic version of Leinenkugel's summer shandy.

items.title: California enacts non-ultraprocessed label despite concern from food industry groups
items.summary: While the new seal is meant to provide a simple way for consumers to identify healthier options, some worry it could lead to more confusion.

items.title: BAT Predicts Fast Growth In Smoking Alternatives For The Next Decade
items.summary: British American Tobacco said it expects annual revenue from selling smoking alternatives to grow by a mid-teens percentage until 2030.

items.title: Data breach at Jims underestimated: 150,000 members affected
items.summary: A cyberattack on the Jims fitness chain appears to be much larger than initially thought. Hackers stole personal data from approximately 150,000 members and are now offering it for sale on the dark web. Parent company Colruyt Group is warning of phishing and potential financial…

items.title: India's Sunflower Oil Imports Seen Up 30% On Duty Cut, Industry Official Says
items.summary: India's sunflower oil imports are likely to rise 30% in the 2026/27 marketing year to 3.5 million metric tonnes.

items.title: Lidl launches new private label for dogs and cats
items.summary: “Max & Mila’s World”: that’s the name under which Lidl is rolling out a revamped line of dog and cat products in all its stores. With three premium lines, 100% natural recipes, and transparent labels, the discount retailer makes choosing the right product easier and more…

items.title: Iconic Antwerp bakery Goossens has new owners
items.summary: The 140-year-old Antwerp bakery Goossens is embarking on a new chapter under new ownership. For customers, little will change: the Goossens name, the store, and the familiar recipes and products will all remain the same.

items.title: Dutch Sugar Tax Could Boost Cross-Border Shopping – EFMI
items.summary: Dutch sugar tax plans could boost cross-border shopping and cost the treasury hundreds of millions, an EFMI study finds.

items.title: “Lidl maintains its lead over Albert Heijn in Flanders”
items.summary: The claim that Albert Heijn has now surpassed Lidl in market share in Flanders deserves some clarification, says spokesperson Isabelle Colbrandt. Based on the YouGov figures, which also include fresh food categories, the discounter maintains a lead.
